{{Youmay|a medical implement|the [[Bi-state memory plastic|building material]]}}
'''Memory-plastic''' was a type of [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] created for the medical sector to suture small wounds. The memory-plastic retained its shape, and it dissolved after a [[Galactic Standard Calendar|week]] if kept clean and germ-free.
